name: the way to find the answer

steps.name: The way to find the answer (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Narsha] in 「Guild Alliance City Esnil」, complete the quest with [Raclette].

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hello Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, how are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Maybe something is going on with Narsha...?)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What am I... . I'm doing great… .
(For some reason, behind the smile I put on, I feel sad. Madori, the magic golem on Narsha's shoulder, moves around as if trying to erase that feeling.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori, you are such a good friend… . As much as anise and ambrosia.
(Madori seems to have read Narsha's intention and stops moving.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's a lie to say I'm doing well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: A suspicious person from the Magic Agency came and said he would retrieve Madori. He said he didn't like it, and when I asked who ordered it, he couldn't answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Magic Agency told me to become Madori’s master.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, that's right. He tried to take it by force and screamed, but luckily Zelic and Raclette came over and chased the man away.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: At first, I thought Madori was making an excuse for the Magic Agency because she was curious, but that wasn't the case. He came and tried to steal it three times already, pretending to be someone else... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Even though Mr. Einst, Zelic, Raclette, and the President said they would catch someone like that if they saw him, they would disappear right away... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Maybe a witch….)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I was scared. At first it looked like a different person, but when I reached out, it was the same person. That man... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Man?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes man… . I thought he was a wizard because he was holding a big staff, but he turned out to be more of a shaman... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: So I'm a little scared these days. I can't go anywhere, I just stay here. I feel like they're targeting me, not Madori... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there something else?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: That person also had ears similar to mine. You don't have arms like mine... . To be considered a beastman, there is no tail... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was this what happened… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes? Is this something like this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's nothing.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: If you know anything, can you tell me? Is that person from the Kali tribe? Similar to the people Adventurer knows... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't see that person, so it's hard to say.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I know this is a difficult ask, but would you please take me to where he is?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Sorry... . I was only thinking about myself...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I'm sorry. I'm sorry for not being able to comfort you. Oh, that's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The spirit king I met asked me to tell him that the next person I meet will have the spirit's protection.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank you. The spirit's protection... . uh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I don't know exactly, but I suddenly felt better. It feels like drinking cool ice water.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is it because of her mood? Narsha’s expression seems to have improved...)

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Hello, Narsha. Hello, %s. I was looking for it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zelic, it’s been a while. You were looking for it?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Would you like to eat cake first? I made a lot for Narsha. Raclette told me not to make too much, but I had no choice.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wow, the cakes and cookies are delicious, but I’ve been eating too many these days… .
(Zelik looks sad at Narsha’s words.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Still, I'll try it. He made it for me, but I was also hungry... .

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: I’m looking forward to dinner too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does it taste like this time? It tastes a little different than before... . Oh, this isn't important. Why did you come looking for me?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: I have something to tell you over there for a moment. Narsha, is it okay if I take Adventurer with me?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. By the way, Adventurer, I felt better hearing your story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's good,

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Thank goodness. With that in mind, I'll also leave here Jelly's homemade Madori jelly.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Now, Adventurer. Let's go to where Raclette is.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori, can you feel that you are full of energy too? That's strange. Why is that so?

steps.name: The way to find the answer (2)
steps.objective: Explore “Western El Anor Plains” and meet and talk to unexpected people. Then report to [Dana] in “Guild Alliance City Esnir.”

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Jelly, cake doesn't taste good. No, I can't eat it. Take it and go back. I'm sick of it, I'm still eating it every day... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This time, instead of bringing a cake, he came with me.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Ah, you are %s. Zelic brought you here for that.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: It's Narsha's job.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Yes, this is a story about a suspicious person who targeted Narsha not long ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard they went back and forth three times.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: In the center of Guild Alliance Esnil, security is tight to prevent suspicious people from entering.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Because President Dana is there, people who work in the Sylvarian Empire's council or the imperial palace can also come in with permission.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: There is a barrier set up by the guild's wizards knowingly or unknowingly... .

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: To have come in without such a barrier, the guild union guards, and the eyes of countless powerful people... .

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: After all, I am not an ordinary person.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: The information I've gathered so far is that ears similar to Narsha's, a shaman, and others appeared in the Plains of El Anor.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Members of the Guard and Moonlight are searching the plains, but other than that, there are no other clues left.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: So, since you're here, I'd like to help you out a little bit. Narsha's magic golem was brought from the Magic Agency... .

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: If it connects with people and events related to it, it could be a big problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's a big deal... If those things come together, it'll make Iris dangerous, right?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, Medea’s words come to mind. If you approach the end as if you are being led by fate, you may find the answer….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That’s right. I somehow ended up here….)

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: What are you thinking like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. So what can I do to help you?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: We'll be exploring the eastern and southern plains and the mountainous areas on our own, so I'd like you to check out the western plains to see if there are any strange traces.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: %s might be able to see things that we can't.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Since this is an official request from the guild, you will be paid properly. First, take my cake... .

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Zelic, put that away. %s, don't give it to me, leave it.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: You’re heartless, Raclette.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where does cake like that come from?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Hehe, the elf's pocket is a magic pocket.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: If you talk about desserts and cakes to Zelic, there will be no end to it, so stop. Now please explore.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The road to the west of the plains is quite far, so I'll start first.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Just take a look around and come back. Zelic, let’s go too.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Zelic, stop. Don't take the cake with the intention of eating it on the go. Not even pudding.
(%s's steps stop in a seemingly quiet place in the western part of El Anor Plain, where the kobold guard unit was located.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was a path like this here. The road to Knossos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, but this feeling... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Someone is watching me from behind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It doesn't seem like there is any intention to attack, but you still have to be careful.)
This is a place where passage is prohibited by the Sylvaria Empire... . you are… .
(A familiar person appears from the inside of the road and blocks the road.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is Argent here?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: This is what I want to say. %s, what brought you here? Because it could be an obstruction to official business... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. uh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Are you feeling inexplicable again?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The feeling I just felt wasn't Argent's. It was definitely a similar feeling to that of the woman who appeared instead of Medea.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Did you feel anything here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's because of my mood. Something embarrassing happened to someone in the guild association, so I was looking for something.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Is this a guild union thing? You can tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… , yes. then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Simply tell Argent that you are looking for traces of a suspicious person.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Did something like that happen to a girl named Narsha?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: He's like a shaman with animal ears... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I will ask the partisans on the Knossos Road. Please wait a moment.
(As soon as Argent finishes speaking, he goes inside the street.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does the fact that Argent and the guerrillas are here mean that it is the land of the Empire? It looks like he's still distracted by the kobolds on the plains... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Hmm… .
(After a while, Argent walks out with a suspicious expression.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: There is a person whose facial expression is similar to what %s mentioned. However, it is said that he stayed with the guerrillas for almost a month and did not come out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The Knossos region has long been under the watchful eye of the Empire. It was occupied for the reason of preparing for the threat of beastmen, and now it is an abandoned area.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: So, if prisoners want to go somewhere else, they must get permission from the Sylvaria Empire's guerrilla post.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Since I am not in charge of this place, this is all I can say. Even if you are %s, you do not have permission to enter here right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You need permission from the Empire, right?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes. First of all, I hope you will pass on that message when you pass away. And I will make a suggestion regarding permission.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. But what brings Argent here?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: There was a matter of Congress. I'm sorry I can't tell you more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Then I'll go. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: See you later then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Knossos is a place related to the Empire, so it would be best to tell Dana, right?)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Is something happening?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: (I guess I should investigate the humans at the Magic Agency….)

steps.name: The way to find the answer (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Chloris] at the 「Magic Academy Main Building」 and obtain <School Festival Records>. Then report to [Medea] in Kali.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dana, you are there.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yeah, I wasn't going anywhere, I was waiting for %s.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Raclette and Zelic returned from patrol, but there was nothing to gain.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Okay, what do you think?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I couldn't find any traces of the suspicious person, but I received help from Argent.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There was Argent? No, keep talking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Artgent asked at the guerrilla post, but they said no prisoners came out.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's right. The prisoners there always have to get permission from the guard post when moving around. Even if they move to their own territory... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way. I felt something strange.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Which one?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I felt like someone was there watching me.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hmm… . Since I don't know who you are, could you tell me which situation or person in %s's experience is similar to that of you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's her... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Witch?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But it’s different again. To be exact, that's what it felt like, but it wasn't that woman. Like someone else... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm sorry. There isn't much information about witches. I've never been to the territory of the Beast Man Empire. Because there was no need to go. At least I... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Still, I'll look for some information.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And I have a question for %s. It was definitely not a coincidence that you came to Narsha, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . Here's how it happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Medea's story is brought up to Dana, who noticed the process of finding the answer.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Superhuman Medea… . I was already curious about what kind of person he was, but to have such a painful fate... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Witch… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I think it will lead to his decision because our sisters also have to solve that problem.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And these days, the side of Eastland is growing tremendously. Maybe it's something waiting for that day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Vice… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you for caring about Narsha. I will find out more about that suspicious entity.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, since Dana says so, it won't be a big deal. thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you have anything to say?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: One day, Jade said she saw a book at Magic Academy Zerenis that recorded the early days of the school festival. If I find it and give it to him, I think he'll find out something.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Because the name of the school festival is Daphne... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe so.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I got it. Then I will bring it to you. See you later, Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Okay, see you later.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You are here. I was waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You must be tired, so get some tea… . No, I will stop serving that car now. Let me give you something else.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you for being willing to go on this journey for me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So would you mind telling us a story? What happened… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I will. First, let me tell you the story of my visit to Noel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Medea about meeting Noel, Titi, Narin, and Narsha and following the traces of a suspicious man.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You've had a lot going on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And I have something for you. Here's the book.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What book is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dana gave me information about a book about the school festival held at Magic Academy Zerenis, and I found it and brought it back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it because it contains magical power? . I couldn't see the letters clearly. If you are Mediah, you might be able to see it.
(He takes the book from Medea and begins to look at it slowly.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Speaking of school festival... . Is this a festival where young children are taught?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's an event like that at a school.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm jealous. In Freios, there is a place like this where children can learn and have fun... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The people of Eastland, including our Kali people, don't have much of that experience.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: For those who faced life and death in long-term conflicts and battles, survival came first.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sorry. You said something pointless. I'm going to look at the book a little more, so can you wait? I don’t know if my magic power can check the contents of this book, but… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank goodness. I can confirm it with my magic power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Then, I will drink the tea you provided.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The name of the school festival is ‘Daphne’… ? His name… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It was named after the time when the school festival was started and established to coincide with the reign of the emperor.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It was at that exact time that our clan was chased by the cult and left our beloved land.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … The school festival is a place for excellent students who learn magic to show off their skills... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It is written that accidents were frequent in the beginning, and it is said that some of the students were killed or went missing due to a golem.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In particular, the missing place is the Knossos Road... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Okay, now I get it. Why did I feel that way... .
(Medea goes to the flower bed behind her and looks at the growing plant. After a while, a small fire breaks out from the roots and burns all the leaves and stems of the plant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will never have this car again. That was the one thing left... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And I might end up there soon.
